name: tps26600
watch_out_for: TI SLVSDG2G PWP0016A review: OUT is pins 15 and 16; NC is 4 and 13; PowerPAD is 17. RTN 8 and PowerPAD 17 MUST remain separate from system GND 9. Corrected imported undersized PowerPAD to 5.0 x 3.4 mm copper with 3.3 mm square mask/paste opening, nine 0.30 mm thermal drills and rear mask tenting. Paste example assumes 0.125 mm stencil. Generic imported 3D body does not define PowerPAD geometry. Not assembled-hardware validation.
